info.title: Asset Registry Service
info.description:
eGov DIGIT Asset Registry service. Manages solar/electro-mechanical assets (inverters, panels, batteries, etc.) installed at facilities, along with their AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) records, AMC visits, and workflow status transitions.

**Authentication**: This API does NOT use a header-based Authorization scheme. Every request body carries a `RequestInfo` object whose `authToken` field holds the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's OAuth login (`/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login`). The `RequestInfo.userInfo` object (uuid, userName, roles, etc.) identifies the calling user. Services validate `RequestInfo.authToken` server-side against egov-user; there is no separate `Authorization:` header.

**Note on implementation status**: Several endpoints declared by this controller (`/v1/asset/bulk/_create`, `/v1/asset/amc/_create`, `/v1/asset/amc/_update`, `/v1/asset/amc/_search`, `/v1/asset/amc/visit/_create`, `/v1/asset/amc/visit/_update`, `/v1/asset/amc/visit/_search`, `/v1/asset/workflow/{assetID}/_update`) are stubbed and currently always return `501 Not Implemented`. They are documented here because they are live, routable endpoints, with a note in their description.

post.description: Validates and persists a new asset (e.g. inverter, panel, battery) against MDMS master data, checks for duplicates (assetTypeID + serialNumber + brandID + modelNumber), generates an assetId, and raises a create event on the `save-asset` Kafka topic.

requestBody.description: Asset data to be added to the registry

post.description: Validates and updates an existing asset identified by the `assetID` query parameter. Re-validates the asset payload (MDMS masters, duplicates) before persisting the update.

parameters.name: assetID
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the asset to update

post.description: Searches for assets matching the given criteria (tenantId is mandatory; assetID, facilityID, assetType, serialNumber, modelNumber, brandID, wfStatus, isOperational and activityFacilityID are optional filters), with pagination via `offset`/`limit` query parameters. Also returns documents attached to each matched asset.
